summary: TPG Private Equity Opportunities, L.P. filed a Form 8-K under Items 3.02 and 8.01 to report a routine private placement of unregistered limited partnership units. On May 1, 2026, the fund sold 2,487,516 units across three classes for aggregate consideration of $78.8 million, part of its continuous private offering exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. The filing also discloses the transactional net asset value methodology but does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. This is an ordinary capital-raising activity.
